0022600164.text: The Mavericks (3-2, on a two-game win streak, 4th in the Southwest and 7th in the West) host a Sacramento Kings team that is 0-5 and has lost five straight, sitting 15th in the West. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-2 in favor of Sacramento, and the Kings won their most recent meeting 130-121 in Dallas on February 26, 2026, with no games yet in the 2026-27 series. Dallas will be without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated).
